comment: Port of Entry ordinary-input authoring route, seed42, standard, zero bots. Static lunar port, 18 required and three optional guards, finite discovery, actual Rail and Turret lessons, three secret locations and fresh transit departure. Accurate aim does not establish eleven-minute pacing, 4:30 par, fresh-player or all difficulty acceptance.

states.name: dock_arrival
states.note: Arrive with the carried or practice entry loadout in a pressure dock. The existing bulkhead is already open and remains open.

states.name: dock_equipment
states.note: Walk to ordinary Rifle discovery, finite Bullets and armor. No pickup occurs merely from standing at an entry spawn.

states.name: earth_over_gantry
states.note: A quiet ten-second view through the actual ballistic freight window establishes Earth and the gantry before the first fight threshold.

states.name: freight_ingress_clear
states.note: Quiet ordinary movement leaves the viewing line laterally, follows the open west aisle and enters around the dormant Clerk before fighting. Cargo flanks clear all four required human Clerks and Sweepers after actual entry; geometry, contact and combat gates stay unchanged.

states.name: freight_arrival
states.note: Complete the physical freight arrival and visit finite recovery before Rail discovery.

states.name: rail_confiscation
states.note: The confiscation cage supplies the normal Railgun and its stock, then a separate ten-Cell supply. Return to the supported 58.25m teaching stance.

states.name: rail_lane_lesson
states.note: Fire the ordinary found Railgun down the long clear lane at the lone 80HP Sweeper. The actual shot/death receipt, rather than the authored separation alone, must establish the lesson.

states.name: rail_lane_arrival
states.note: The cleared lane's real Arrival advances the ordered mission. The ground bypass remains available to ordinary weapons.

states.name: loading_approach
states.note: Walk the cleared freight lane to loading. Recoveries and capture anchors stay outside later fight regions.

states.name: loading_heavy_clear
states.note: The known Heavy returns alone in the loading bay. Use its existing burst, cover and recovery with ordinary equipment.

states.name: loading_recovery
states.note: Complete loading Arrival and ordinary Shotgun, Shells, health, armor and Cells recovery before the Turret lesson. The ground route passes south of the recovery locker and gallery stairs.

states.name: pressure_maintenance_secret
states.note: Inspect the registered six-marked valve and claim finite pressure-maintenance armor and Cells. The corridor passes beneath a supported gallery.

states.name: service_branch_clear
states.note: The optional service fight has two Clerks and one Sweeper. It is not a required predecessor of customs or departure.

states.name: inhabited_service_marker
states.note: Actual party presence after the local clear marks the later prisoner route. Inspect the occupied room behind real pressure glass; it is sealed from gameplay, not a traversable furnished bay.

states.name: crane_overlook_secret
states.note: A real broad service stair climbs the crane overlook through its full-width wall opening. An ordinary ground aisle beside the stairs reaches their southern first tread. Claim finite armor and inspect the registered overlook anchor; no jump or position grant supplies the height.

states.name: gallery_return_to_cover
states.note: Follow the supported gallery link and descend ordinary stairs to the front cover anchor. The observer begins before the isolated Turret activates.

states.name: turret_front_cover_rear_lesson
states.note: Ordinary movement retains the front firing sweep, holds a clear peek until an observed charge, then retreats and holds real cover until strict cancellation proof. It then climbs supported stairs and shoots from the rear. The camera follows the actual living named Turret during approach. Require the actual first shot and typed/captured windup, firing and dead phases; all geometry and timing remain unchanged.

states.name: turret_arrival
states.note: The cleared Turret gallery's Arrival advances the mission. Its former lesson stance does not activate the later customs fight.

states.name: customs_hold_clear
states.note: The customs set piece combines four desk Clerks and three queue Sweepers after the already-cleared introductory Turret. Both galleries overlook its real ground routes.

states.name: impound_and_depot_windows
states.note: Ordinarily drop into the clear west ground aisle, then climb the east stair and skirt the dormant living Turret through the inner supported gallery before taking finite Cells on the north crossing. Observe the impound ship and adjacent depot through real pressure glass from the clear gallery gap between their registered signs. Static landmarks do not prove a tug animation or Tern wave.

states.name: east_stair_and_customs_arrival
states.note: The other gallery has its own normal stair. Return to the actual customs floor Arrival before the final exit threshold.

states.name: duty_free_secret
states.note: Inspect the six-marked duty-free shutter and collect finite Shells. Medkit claims depend on actual health; no manufactured damage makes the optional reward count.

states.name: exit_watch_clear
states.note: The final crest adds two Clerks, a Heavy and the second Turret above the exit hall. Every named death remains required; ordinary travel defense handles real activation.

states.name: transit_arrival
states.note: All six real Arrivals and required groups are cleared. The living ready party reaches the transit pad and the actual local departure prompt.

states.name: transit_departure
states.note: Fresh ordinary Use confirms shared transit departure toward the lunar town. Retained Earth outcomes and the optional route marker remain distinct from NPC timing or invented passengers.
